race.comment: HALLOWED HALLS (1) gave away a big start early doors but worked his way into the race then went home a shade too well over 2110m at Warwick Farm last time out. Very fit but does come back in trip in a race that lacks speed on paper. McDonald sticks which will set most minds at rest. MALBORK CASTLE (4) contested a similar race to this here a fortnight ago and closed well to get up for second in a field of five. Enjoys a soft run from gate two and should be thereabouts again. AURA (10) has been hitting the line well in shorter races, most recently beaten just 0.4 lengths by the in-form Alabama Charm at Warwick Farm. Rock hard fit and crying out for this sort of trip now. AZARAX (3) had every chance but lacked the change of gears required over the mile at Warwick Farm last start. Cherry ripe after four runs back and this step up in trip has come at the right time. The only other runner is BONDI BLOSSOM (5) who needs to improve to be competitive.
